req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should support partial updates via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint, leaving omitted fields unchanged. This necessitates testing for correct handling of partial payloads, ensuring that fields not included in the update request remain unchanged. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct partial update behavior, a negative test to handle invalid task IDs, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior when no fields are updated.

tests.name: test_partial_update_success
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a partial payload updating only the title.
expected: The response payload reflects the updated title and unchanged fields.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Title", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Partial update
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": "Updated Title"})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Expected: Verify partial update
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Title"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Initial Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False

tests.name: test_partial_update_invalid_task_id
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with a partial payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task"})

# Expected: Verify 404 response
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in update_response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_partial_update_no_fields
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with an empty payload.
expected: The response payload reflects no changes to the task.
tests.executable:

# Expected: Verify no changes

assert updated_task['description'] == "Initial Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
